name: flagship-demo
why: The credibility blocker is that no real-LLM run of Murmur has ever been published.
A finished 16 personas x 8 rounds run on ONE real pricing page beats an unfinished 48 x 8 run.
Every number in the gallery is currently MOCK or pending. This config describes the run that replaces 'pending' with a measured result.

inject.text: StackHaven announces a free-tier match plus a one-click importer
inject.note: Fires after round 3 is submitted and lands in the round 4 digest, so personas react to it in the same round they read about it. Inject exactly once. sim_inject_event clamps round to >= current round + 1 and refuses after the final round.

seedMaterial.primary: ONE real pricing or launch page the operator is actually shipping (or a real public pricing page they can link). Fetch it, then pass the extracted text to seed_add_url.
seedMaterial.honestyRule: The entry header MUST state which seeds were real and which were fictional. The bundled Acme Cloud material (murmur-demo/examples/pricing-page.md, FAQ.md, CHANGELOG.md) is FICTIONAL worked-example content. Mixing real and fictional seeds in one run is allowed, but it must be disclosed, not blended.

required: transcript.md — verbatim, unedited, including rejected submissions and retries
billed tokens in/out — the provider's own number, not an estimate
seed, ensemble runCount, personas, rounds, platforms
one honest 'what we would change' paragraph
forbidden: filling any field with an estimate, a projection, or a mock number
cherry-picking the seed after seeing the verdict
editing the transcript to remove unflattering output

harness.consumers: Declarative only. No tool in tools/*.mjs parses this file; the operator or client agent transcribes these values into the MCP tool calls listed in `toolSequence`.
toolSequence: sim_timeline + sim_round_summary for the timeline table
optional: interview_agent / report_agent_ask for one hostile-persona follow-up
valueMapping: personas -> personas_plan({ count }) — tool range is 8..128
rounds -> sim_configure({ rounds }) — tool range is 1..40
inject.round -> sim_inject_event({ round }) — must be < rounds
ensembleRunCount -> world_config / the world's ensemble.runCount setting
platforms -> one platform label per persona in personas_submit; 'both' means the population spans reddit + twitter
harness.headlessDriver: tools/host-llm-run/run.mjs (env: MURMUR_POP, MURMUR_ROUNDS, MURMUR_SEED). It runs the same tool sequence against the real validators, but it is NOT a client-IDE session and must never be published as the flagship.

stretchGoal.onlyAfter: a 16 x 8 real-LLM run is published in gallery/
stretchGoal.reason: The 48 x 8 shape is already covered as a labeled MOCK engine measurement (gallery/scale-benchmark-48x8/). Re-running it with a real LLM is a nice-to-have, not the blocker.

notes: Run inside a real coding agent (Claude Code / Codex CLI / Gemini CLI) with a real host LLM. Publish verbatim transcript + report HTML + report MD into gallery/flagship-<client>-<model>/. No mock LLMs for the flagship. Publish even if the verdict is unflattering — that is the point of the run.
